purpose: Re-measure the five previously selected documents whose original bytes are irrecoverably unavailable. This is a new measurement, not reconstruction of the original Firecrawl measurements.
no_rule_change: v3 qualification is unchanged: at least 300 usable sentences, permitted institutional long-form document type, no section gate.
parser: Jina Reader (local docker, h2c), the operational parser of the later Batch-7 fetches. The original measurements used Firecrawl; the parser difference is the explicit reason this is remeasurement rather than repair.
snapshots: New snapshot tags use the remeasure_ prefix and are never confused with K-series candidates. Pinning: new URL, retrieval timestamp, raw snapshot SHA-256. Old provenance remains in history and is never overwritten.
requalification: Run the frozen v3 qualification and the audited section parser independently on the new snapshots.
no_silent_substitution: A changed verdict does not automatically restore the two-per-domain quota. Any replacement follows the original K-order and is explicitly recorded as a consequence of the remeasurement.
no_corpus_build: until all five remeasurements and their consequences are frozen.
